## Automated publication discovery

A separate [automatically generated bibliography](publications/papers.bib) gathers papers from arXiv, Crossref, dblp, and OpenAlex. It includes the verified entries plus additional **unreviewed candidates**, which may contain duplicate records or namesakes. Papers appear in the public list above only after they have been checked and added to my verified bibliography.
